title: Bulletproof Thighs
description: Stability leg work with assisted pistol squat and forward lunges, finished with a control core block

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Fast lateral movements, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Forward lunges
exercises.instructions: Big step forward, back knee nearly grazes the floor

exercises.name: Floor hip thrust
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, feet flat, raise hips, squeeze the glutes

exercises.name: L-sit hold
exercises.instructions: Hands on the floor, lift straight legs in front of you

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift shoulders off, squeeze the abs

exercises.name: Flutter kicks
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, quick alternating kicks

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Face down, bring one foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
